items.title: Horace "One Leg Horse" White Interview, 1961-03-03
items.q: Guy Kelly used to play some good trumpet.

ctx.x: Man, Guy Kelly was a, Guy Kelly was a whip. Man, Guy Kelly was a, Guy Kelly man, but Guy Kelly was, when he was throwing that chord, when he was throwing that trumpet. Man, look like he make, look like he had, he had harmony in that car, in that car trumpet. Guy Kelly used to play some good trumpet. Him, Big Eye Lowey, Marion Perez, and, uh, the movement, I can't call, I forgot, I forgot the name, but all them, I know them all.
